sycm-shop-report 1.0.0

- Initial release of the skill for generating illustrated Chinese .docx shop-operation reports (daily/weekly/monthly) for Taobao & Tmall merchants using 生意参谋 (SYCM) data.
- Includes WoW/YoY baselines, plain-language conclusions, and prioritized action lists.
- Supports structured workflows with clear dependency and data-validation steps.
- Built-in scripts for report assembly and chart generation; fully data-driven with separation of data and layout.
- Designed for consistent output style, automated exception handling, and supports scheduled tasks.
